def camel_case_to_pep8(name: str) -> str:
    """Convert a camel cased name to PEP8 style."""
    converted = CAPITALS.sub(lambda m: '_' + m.groups()[0].lower(), name)
    return converted[1:] if converted[0] == '_' else converted
